ache.title: Math tables for spending gems. Oh, Nero
ache.note: Tables and calculations on how to best spend Unite gems: licenses, battle passes, skins, chest upgrades. Math makes spending feel responsible, like a budget. But a guide on spending well still starts from the idea that you will spend. The most cost-effective gem is the one you never bought.
watch: when to ‘invest’ in the Battle Pass
ache.tip: Before any gem purchase, ask: would I buy this if no table told me it was a good deal?
lines: spreadsheets don’t make it a budget, Nero
cheapest gem: the one you didn’t buy

videoData.title: How to Best Spend Gems | Pokémon Unite

textData.text: In this video, I dive deep into Pokémon Unite's gacha mechanics and how to effectively manage your resources, whether you're a free-to-play player or a spender. Inspired by a viewer's comment, I discuss the importance of understanding probability and finance in the game and provide a comprehensive guide using tables and calculations to help you make informed decisions. Learn about the different currencies like coins and gems, how to acquire them, and the best ways to use them on licenses, battle passes, and skins. I'll also share cost-effective strategies for spending gems in the gacha system, including optimal chest upgrades and determining when to invest in the Battle Pass. Stay tuned for more detailed guides and feel free to reach out with any questions!
